name: pecan-restaurant-ordering
description: Real-time restaurant ordering prototype: Angular 21 + NgRx client, NestJS server

scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start:prod -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm run test:e2e -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.lint: tsc -p shared && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
